newsitem.title: UK: Argent says buys property from Chesterfield.
newsitem.headline: Argent says buys property from Chesterfield.

text.p: Britain's Argent Group Plc said on Tuesday it had signed contracts to buy the Crystal Peaks shopping centre near Sheffield, nothern England, from Chesterfield Properties Plc for 35.5 million stg.
The centre, covering 300,000 square feet, includes a Sainsbury food store, 50 shops, a 10 screen cinema, 1900 parking spaces, a health centre and covered market, the company said in a statement.

Argent said the price reflected a net investment yield of 6.2 percent, which it expected to rise to more than nine percent in late 1998 after rent reviews and the letting of a proposed phase of 60,000 square feet of shopping.
The property was developed by Chesterfield in the late 1980s and serves the residential growth areas of Sheffield.
Robert Laurence, investment director of Argent, said the company had invested more than 100 million stg in the retail sector in the last six months.
About 67 percent of Argent's 370 million stg investment portfolio was now in retail and leisure, the company said.
